auditTitle: Workspace Compaction — W1 Architecture & Reliability Audit
scope: Read-only audit; no production source changed; no live model used; no user chats altered

directlyReproduced: C1 capacity refresh behavior (two-slot / reload scenarios)
Checkpoint array cap / brief truncation (51 briefs trims newest)
Stale cache reproduction (same session/model/port with changed capacity)
Image approximate fallback (4,096 allowance, approximate method)
inspectedNotExecuted: Full Electron UI fixtures (sandbox blocked by EPERM)
Cloud parent recovery path (no test exercised)

hypothesisRequiringFutureInvestigation: Repeated compaction preserves all newly added requirements when brief exceeds 50
Parent adapter can achieve same-run continuation for runs >500 tool turns
Irreducible floor measurement for all realistic Workspace configurations
Under-5K target feasibility for tasks with >50 brief records or large checkpoints

testedBehaviors.behavior: C1 unified runtime budget and 90% trigger
testedBehaviors.outcome: Budget contract uses verified runtime capacity when available; 90% trigger computed as floor(usableInput * 0.90); reserve includes output/reasoning + safety

testedBehaviors.method: Temporary SQLite database; simulated assistant persistence updates; atomic rollback verification
testedBehaviors.outcome: 5/5 focused tests pass; idle refuses when active message in_progress; forced stops at first in_progress or excluded; atomic rollback on status transition
testedBehaviors.preEditReproductionOutcome: 2/5 pass; 3 fail (forced preservation, rollback, live first row irreducible)

testedBehaviors.method: Adversarial deterministic input (51 brief IDs); size-floor measurement
testedBehaviors.outcome: 51 brief IDs => validator trims to cap 50; newest brief omitted silently with repair note; checkpoint byte cap uses string length, not UTF-8 bytes

testedBehaviors.behavior: Stale capacity cache after backend change
testedBehaviors.method: Mocked measurer; same session/model/port/hash with different capacity
testedBehaviors.outcome: Cache returns previous 35,072 limit after capacity changed to 16,384; payload-only hits skip /props refresh

testedBehaviors.method: Payload with image_url part; approximate full-request calculation
testedBehaviors.outcome: Multimodal request bypasses template/tokenizer; uses bytes/3 + 4,096 per image + role allowance; image count and allowance returned in measurement
testedBehaviors.evidence: docs/context-c1-unified-budget-report.md section Measurement, images and UI

testedBehaviors.method: Literal production callback invocation with adversarial responses (empty, reasoning-only with finish_reason=length, partial summary, truncated JSON, unsupported tool-bearing response)
testedBehaviors.outcome: Reasoning-only / truncated / tool-bearing responses not rejected by parent callbacks; empty summary rejected later; checkpoint parsing throws on truncated JSON; no structured-output enforcement

testedBehaviors.method: Snapshot identity computed from brief IDs; commit validates identity unchanged
testedBehaviors.outcome: Brief identity checked before archival and at commit; applicable briefs derived from active message path; revisions supersede prior rows; full brief text preserved in DB
testedBehaviors.evidence: docs/context-c1-unified-budget-report.md section Scheduling and strict dispatch; docs/workspace-compaction-w1-audit.md section 9
